books.title: Eagles (Songbook)
flags: Specific book title unknown; contents low-res so page numbers missing.

books.title: Liszt: Liebesträume — Drei Notturnos (Henle Urtext)
flags: Cover only. Three Liebesträume to be filled in enrichment.

songs.title: Liebestraum No. 1 in A-flat major: "Hohe Liebe" (Andante)
songs.notes: After Ludwig Uhland's poem 'Hohe Liebe'; piano transcription of Liszt's own song.

songs.title: Liebestraum No. 2 in E major: "Seliger Tod" (Quasi lento, abbandonandosi)
songs.notes: After Uhland's poem 'Seliger Tod' (blessed death).

songs.title: Liebestraum No. 3 in A-flat major: "O lieb, so lang du lieben kannst" (Poco allegro, con affetto)
songs.notes: The famous one; after Ferdinand Freiligrath's poem. Features two demanding cadenzas.

books.title: O Brother, Where Art Thou? (Soundtrack)
flags: Identified from song list; no title text on page.
books.title_suggestion: O Brother, Where Art Thou? — Music from the Motion Picture Soundtrack (Hal Leonard, PVG)
books.identification_note: Track list and performer attributions match the 2000 T Bone Burnett-produced soundtrack exactly. The captured 'from' fields are the recording artists, retained as printed; the underlying film is O Brother, Where Art Thou?

songs.title: "YOU ARE MY SUNSHINE"
songs.notes: Credited to Davis/Mitchell; soundtrack version performed by Norman Blake.

songs.title: "DOWN TO THE RIVER TO PRAY"
songs.notes: Traditional spiritual; arranged for the 2000 soundtrack.

songs.title: "I AM A MAN OF CONSTANT SORROW"
songs.notes: Traditional; soundtrack vocal by Dan Tyminski. Film's signature song.

songs.title: "KEEP ON THE SUNNY SIDE"
songs.notes: Popularized by the Carter Family; written ca. 1899.

songs.title: "DIDN'T LEAVE NOBODY BUT THE BABY"
songs.composer: Gillian Welch, T Bone Burnett, Alan Lomax
songs.original_artist: Emmylou Harris, Alison Krauss and Gillian Welch
songs.notes: Adapted from the traditional 'Go to Sleep, Little Baby'; the sirens' song.

songs.title: "IN THE HIGHWAYS"
songs.notes: Credited to Maybelle Carter; performed by the Peasall Sisters.

songs.title: "IN THE JAILHOUSE NOW"
songs.notes: Soundtrack vocal by Tim Blake Nelson.

songs.title: "ANGEL BAND"
songs.notes: Hymn 'My Latest Sun Is Sinking Fast'; Stanley Brothers' recording closes the film.
